fit: Center retained and missing native product writes; top32 PCA directions of retained training covariance; ridge regression to centered missing write, lambda=.001*trace(projected Gram)/32. Add missing training mean. No task fitting.
theory: If missing write Y is conditionally predictable from retained X via a low-rank linear map, transfer error can fall below mean-only replacement even when identity scaling fails. PCA regression tests only this sufficient form. Conditional residuals or nonlinear dependencies can defeat it; failure cannot exclude all redundancy.
causal_evaluation: Keep retained native channels and Down bias; replace only missing contribution using retained write plus training constants. Evaluate all160 original task endpoints and32 natural evaluation documents, native upstream and live downstream. Compare M41 raw half/doubling outputs and new mean/map arms. Map inference does not use missing native write; native used for scoring only.
selection: All6directional maps retained. No rank/ridge/mask tuning, evaluation selection, or task-holdout exposure.
limits: Repaired computation with added learned parameters is not literal removal robustness or proof of semantic duplicates. Local prediction must be supplemented by output intervention; finite familiar development data.
stopping: One fixed rank/ridge comparison, audited training before native evaluation; then revise mechanism account before further fits.
